ns2:course.label: Engineering Law
ns2:course.description: Nature and development of the legal system; legal rights and duties important to engineers in their professions; contracts, uniform commercial code and sales of goods, torts, agency, worker's compensation, labor law, property, environmental law, intellectual property. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: RHET 105.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: RHET 105.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
